description: This file defines the SQLAlchemy declarative Base class for ORM models and imports specific model modules to register them within the ORM registry and enable database schema creation and migration detection.

classes.name: Base
classes.description: Declarative base class for all ORM models.

methods.name: pass
methods.description: No additional methods defined; this class inherits from DeclarativeBase.
